name: m4-release-main-int-jdk26
description: Full compile of scalap on the M4: the 2.13.18 release vs 2.13.x (main) vs retronym's refreshed `scala2-perf-integration`, with and without retronym/scala#148, each build in its own forks (one scala-library each, so not paired).

All builds compiled with the release optimizer settings (`-opt:l:inline -opt-inline-from:scala/**`, the lab's `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), ~50 s warmup, 2 rounds.

variantDescriptions.int: `scala2-perf-integration` refreshed onto `278cab1040` (`195578522f`): open perf PRs scala/scala#11307, #11306, #11312, #11350, #11352, #11353 rebased, plus the Symbol.filter allocation fix
variantDescriptions.int148: int + retronym/scala#148 (typing transformers' contexts made lazily), `70634e2e68`
